sections.heading: Clarification on Environmental Clearance Near Vembanad Lake
sections.content: Para 1: All commercial projects >3,000 sq.m. within 500m of Vembanad Lake require prior SEIAA environmental clearance.

sections.heading: SEIAA Application Forms and Timelines
sections.content: Para 3: SEIAA application forms approved; standard processing timeline for SEIAA environmental clearance is 30 days.
